parsed.name: PVI设备连接组件
parsed.description: 用于建立与维护PVI设备通信会话的非物理连接组件，负责连接状态管理与接口转发。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical connector component that establishes and maintains communication sessions with PVI devices, handling connection state and interface forwarding.

actions.description: 根据设备的类型注解自动创建子设备和信号占位项，便于后续由 PVI 信息补全。
actions.description_en: Automatically create child device and signal placeholders from the device type annotations so they can later be populated from PVI data.

actions.description: 连接到模拟对象并为设备及其子项设置名称，用于测试或仿真环境。
actions.description_en: Connect to a mock object and assign names to the device and its children for testing or simulation.

actions.description: 连接真实的 PVI 结构，依据返回内容补全子项，并检查所请求的子项是否都已正确填充。
actions.description_en: Connect to the real PVI structure, populate children from the returned information, and verify that all requested children have been filled correctly.
